vt.m02.title: The event
vt.m02.qtypes: Three kinds of question: position, which flag, and whether it appeared
vt.m02.formatAlt: There are {rounds} rounds. Every player takes one turn as the setter.
vt.m02.pickNote: The setter sees only the kind and number of flags, not the layout or answers
vt.m02.hostNote: The setter sees the same flags and answers the same 5 questions
vt.m02.tie3: Total time on correct answers (shorter is better)
vt.m02.talkNote: The next setter sees the candidates during the break, and when choosing may tell others which one was picked, truthfully or not
vt.m02.boost: Spend a piece for more time
vt.m02.boostNote: Up to twice per event, not twice in the same round
vt.m02.practice: Practice: memorize the flags and answer 5 questions.
vt.m03.title: The event
vt.m03.nofill: Here you do not need to fill every cell; linking every symbol completes the puzzle
vt.m03.doLink: Try it: drag from an endpoint and link all 3 symbols
vt.m03.formatAlt: Players form {pairs} pairs. There are {rounds} rounds; partners change each round and never repeat.
vt.m03.formatOdd: With an odd number of players, one player has no partner each round
vt.m03.hintNote: The ◆ cell is on that symbol's line (partner's 4th puzzle, visible only to you)
vt.m03.shareNote: Choose to share your clue or not; you may also talk. While solving you see only your own board
vt.m03.tieNote: Ties: puzzles solved, then total solving time (shorter is better)
vt.m03.aid: Spend pieces to see a start
vt.m04.title: The event
vt.m04.formatAlt: Players sit three to a table, at {n} tables. Final ranking uses each player's own score across all tables.
vt.m04.formatAltMix: Players sit at {n} tables of two or three. Final ranking uses each player's own score across all tables.
vt.m04.routeNote: Pick a mission to see the route and toll (the cheapest route is used)
vt.m04.tollNote: Others' track: pay {n} per section to the owner
vt.m04.talkNote: During this time, talk with your table about cooperation or deals
vt.m04.aid: Spend pieces to swap a mission
vt.m04.aidNote: Once, before the event starts. Choose from 2 candidates worth the same
vt.m05.hostAns: The setter answers with the same cards
vt.m05.title: The event
vt.m05.formatAlt: Players split into two groups. There are {rounds} rounds, and the groups are reshuffled after round {half}.
vt.m05.setterAlt: Each group takes turns as setter. The setter picks one target from three public candidates, and also answers.
vt.m05.once: Each card once at most; you need not use them all
vt.m05.frac: Fractions along the way are fine; the result must match exactly
vt.m05.shareNote: You can talk between rounds, not while solving. The setter sees the cards first and may tell the group
vt.m05.extra: Spend a piece for an extra card
vt.m05.extraNote: Once per round, {n} times per event
vt.m05.tie3: Total answer time (shorter is better; misses count as 90 sec)
vt.m06.title: The event
vt.m06.formatAlt: An individual event for {n} players over {rounds} rounds, using your hand and the public field cards.
vt.m06.passNote: Pass if you do not swap. Cards you put in the field are public. Turn order shifts each round
vt.m06.upTo2: Everyone at once lays down up to 2 cards face down
vt.m06.topNote: Among those who met the target, the highest 2-card sum gets +3 (ties all get it)
vt.m06.lastNote: No refill after the last round
vt.m06.both: If both, only the higher one
vt.m06.talkNote: You can talk only in the 20 sec between rounds. Hands stay hidden
vt.m06.aidNote: Once per event. Cannot be undone
vt.m07.once: Same size, different shape. Once per event
vt.m07.title: The event
vt.m07.boardAlt: {n} players share one hexagonal board of 61 cells. The center cell is a tower where no one may place.
vt.m07.tower: The center cell is a tower; no one can place there
vt.m07.doPlace: Try it: pick the 2-cell tile, tap the board, then press Place
vt.m07.lowFirst: Each round, lowest score goes first
vt.m07.lost: If someone takes your marker cell, you cannot achieve it
vt.m07.promise: Keeping promises is up to each player
vt.m07.aid: Spend pieces to swap a tile
vt.m07.maxRounds: rounds at most (also ends if all pass)
vt.m07.tie3: Cells left in tiles (fewer is better)
vt.m08.title: The event
vt.m08.boardAlt: {n} players share one board. You start at an outer corner; your goal is the flag of your color on the far side.
vt.m08.noBlockNote: You cannot cut off anyone's last route to the goal, only make it longer
vt.m08.auto: On timeout you step toward your goal automatically (or pass)
vt.m08.first: The first player rotates each round
vt.m08.goalOut: Arrived pieces leave the board and take no more turns
vt.m08.maxRounds: rounds at most (ends if one is left)
vt.m08.noAid: No piece-based help in this event
vt.m09.title: The event
vt.m09.boardAlt: {n} players on a 7×7 board. Each corner holds one king and three soldiers.
vt.m09.kingLostNote: If your king is taken, play on with your soldiers
vt.m09.auto: On timeout a move is made for you (or pass)
vt.m09.first: The first player rotates each round
vt.m09.out: Lose all pieces and you take no more turns; your points stay
vt.m09.maxRounds: rounds at most (ends if one remains)
vt.m10.title: The event
vt.m10.boardAlt: {n} players on a triangle of 15 points. Each corner has a flag with two soldiers beside it.
vt.m10.noEnter: You cannot enter your own soldiers' points or flags. Flags do not move
vt.m10.oneAct: At your flag, spend a separate move to deliver; just arriving is not enough
vt.m10.drop: A captured soldier drops its gem; the captor picks it up if empty-handed
vt.m10.auto: On timeout: deliver if possible, else move automatically (or pass)
vt.m10.coop: You may team up, and stop teaming up
vt.m10.lostNote: With no soldiers you take no turns; your points stay
vt.m01.formatAlt: Players split into {groups} groups of {size}. There are {stages} stages, {sec} seconds each.
vt.m01.betweenText: There is a {sec}-second break between stages. It starts early once everyone is ready. After stage {half}, the groups are reshuffled and from stage {next} you work with different people. The frame grows larger as the stages go on.
vt.m01.title: The event
vt.m01.doRotate: Try it: pick a piece and press Rotate
vt.m01.doPlace: Now place that piece inside the frame
vt.m01.doHint: Try it: press Hint (free during the tutorial)
vt.m01.hintOnce: In the real match it costs 2 pieces, once per event
hid.deny.clues: A six-digit dial. You can't turn it blind. {n} more conditions seem to be somewhere in this study.

intro.title: Introductions
intro.gatherText: The contestants gather in {place} and form a circle. Once everyone is in place, each person introduces themselves in turn.
intro.doneText: The contestants head off to different parts of the building. Free time until noon. Gather at the 1F Tournament Arena at 12:00.
cer.nextText: In {place}, the contestants stand in a circle and introduce themselves one by one. Free time starts afterwards.
credits.introVoice: Contestants without a recorded introduction are introduced with subtitles only.
